2.15.6 Subreport.DataElementName
The Subreport.DataElementName element specifies the name to use for the data element or
attribute of a Subreport. This element is optional. If this element is present, it MUST be a CLS-
compliant identifier [UTR15]. If this element is not present, its value defaults to the name of the
subreport.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.DataElementName element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.DataElementName element.
 <xsd:element name="DataElementName" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
